item.title: Artist And Producer: Inside Jackson Dean’s Long-Running Partnership With ‘Brother’ Luke Dick
item.description:
[Intro music plays]
Host: Welcome to "Trending on Billboard", the podcast where we dive into the latest music news and trends. I'm your host, [Name], and today we're talking about Jackson Dean's new album, Magnolia Sage.
[Background music transitions]
Host: Jackson Dean has always been known for his gritty persona, but with Magnolia Sage, he's putting a different spin on things. His first album with Big Machine, Greenbroke, had a distinct swampy sound, but only one love song. Fast forward to now, and Dean is fully embracing love and relationships in his music, exploring more soul textures with his latest release on Blue Highway label.
[Music clip from Magnolia Sage plays]
Host: So, what's behind this new direction? For one, Dean's recent engagement in January 2026 has clearly had an impact. But he also credits his ongoing collaboration with producer Luke Dick, who he met at a party in 2019. The two have developed a strong musical partnership, with Dick bringing his experience and expertise to the table.
[Clip of Jackson Dean speaking]
Host: Dean describes their relationship as a musical brotherhood, with Dick as a sensei and him as a student. But as they've worked together, it's clear that they bring different strengths to the table. Dick's passion for exploring new music and his willingness to take risks have been a big influence on Dean's new sound.
[Music clip from The Barr Brothers plays]
Host: The two are clearly passionate about music, and their differences have created a unique sound. Dean's ethereal creativity combined with Dick's concrete reality has resulted in something special. As Luke Dick recalls, his own journey in the music industry began with humble beginnings, rebuilding a double-wide trailer in exchange for engineering experience.
[Outro music plays]
Host: That's all for today's episode of "Trending on Billboard". Thanks for tuning in to learn more about Jackson Dean's new album, Magnolia Sage, and his collaboration with producer Luke Dick. Until next time, keep on listening! [Outro music continues to play]
